en.s: The Battle of Roslin was one of the most important battles of the First War of Scottish Independence. A monument cairn erected by the Roslin Heritage Society at the end of the 20th century marks the site of the battle which took place on 24 February 1303. It was, with between 30,000 and 35,000 dead, the bloodiest battle ever fought on British soil. The Scottish historian John of Fordun wrote this description of the battle: "There never was so desperate a struggle, or one in which the stoutness of knightly prowess shone forth so brightly.

zh.s: 罗斯林战役于1303年2月24日发生，是第一次苏格兰独立战争中最重要的战役之一。20世纪末，罗斯林遗产协会在战场旧址竖立了一座纪念石堆。原文称此战造成3万至3.5万人死亡，是英国本土发生过的最血腥战役。苏格兰历史学家福尔登的约翰写道：“从未有过如此殊死的搏斗，也从未有过一场战斗，让骑士勇武如此耀眼地展现。”

en.t: Charles III dies after an assassination attack
en.s: On February 24, 1386, Charles III of Naples, who also claimed the Hungarian throne as Charles II, died of his wounds at Visegrád, in present-day Hungary. The assassination attack had occurred on February 7.

zh.t: 查理三世在遭遇暗杀袭击后伤重去世
zh.s: 1386年2月24日，那不勒斯国王查理三世在今匈牙利维谢格拉德伤重去世。他也以查理二世之名争夺匈牙利王位。此前的暗杀袭击发生在2月7日。

en.t: Margaret’s forces defeat Albert at Åsle
en.s: On February 24, 1389, Queen Margaret’s forces defeated King Albert of Mecklenburg at Åsle, in present-day Sweden. Albert and his son Erik were captured.

zh.t: 玛格丽特的军队在奥斯勒击败阿尔伯特
zh.s: 1389年2月24日，玛格丽特女王的军队在今瑞典奥斯勒击败梅克伦堡的阿尔伯特国王，俘虏阿尔伯特及其儿子埃里克。

en.s: The Battle of Pavia, fought on the morning of 24 February 1525, was the decisive engagement of the Italian War of 1521–26. An Imperial–Spanish army under the nominal command of Charles de Lannoy (and working in conjunction with the garrison of Pavia, commanded by Antonio de Leyva) attacked the French army under the personal command of Francis I of France in the great hunting preserve of Mirabello outside the city walls. In the four-hour battle, the French army was split and defeated in detail. The French suffered massive casualties, including many of the chief nobles of France.

zh.s: 1525年2月24日早晨，帕维亚战役爆发，这是1521—1526年意大利战争的决定性战役。名义上由夏尔·德拉努瓦指挥的帝国—西班牙联军，配合安东尼奥·德莱瓦率领的帕维亚守军，在城墙外的米拉贝洛大型狩猎场，攻击法国国王弗朗索瓦一世亲自统率的法军。四小时的战斗中，法军被分割并各个击破，伤亡惨重，其中包括许多法国高级贵族。

en.t: Ferdinand I is crowned King of Bohemia in Prague
en.s: On February 24, 1527, Ferdinand I was crowned King of Bohemia in Prague, in present-day Czechia. This was distinct from his Hungarian coronation later that year and his later imperial title.

zh.t: 斐迪南一世在布拉格加冕为波希米亚国王
zh.s: 1527年2月24日，斐迪南一世在今捷克布拉格加冕为波希米亚国王。这与他当年稍后在匈牙利的加冕，以及后来取得皇帝头衔，是不同事件。

en.s: The Treaty of Nagyvárad (or Treaty of Grosswardein) was a secret peace agreement between Emperor Ferdinand I and John Zápolya, rival claimants to the Kingdom of Hungary, signed in Grosswardein / Várad (modern-day Oradea, Romania) on February 24, 1538. In the treaty, they divided Hungary between them. Ferdinand recognized Zápolya as John I, King of Hungary and ruler of two-thirds of the Kingdom, while Zápolya conceded the rule of Ferdinand over western Hungary, and recognized him as heir to the Hungarian throne, since Zápolya was childless. But in 1540, just before Zápolya's death, his wife bore him a son, John Sigismund Zápolya, and the agreement failed.

zh.s: 1538年2月24日，争夺匈牙利王位的斐迪南一世与扎波尧伊·亚诺什，在大瓦拉德，也就是今罗马尼亚奥拉迪亚签署秘密和平协议，史称《大瓦拉德条约》，德文名亦称《格罗斯瓦尔代因条约》。双方约定分治匈牙利：斐迪南承认扎波尧伊为匈牙利国王亚诺什一世，统治王国三分之二的地区；扎波尧伊承认斐迪南统治匈牙利西部，且因自己没有子嗣，承认斐迪南为匈牙利王位继承人。但1540年扎波尧伊临死前，妻子生下儿子扎波尧伊·亚诺什·日格蒙德，协议因而未能实行。

en.t: With the papal bull Inter gravissimas, Pope Gregory XIII announces the Gregorian calendar
en.s: Inter gravissimas (English: "Among the most serious...") was a papal bull issued by Pope Gregory XIII on 24 February 1582. The document, written in Latin, reformed the Julian calendar. The reform has conventionally come to be regarded as a new calendar in its own right, called the Gregorian calendar, named after Pope Gregory XIII.

zh.t: 教宗谕令《Inter gravissimas》颁布，格里高利历由此确立
zh.s: 《Inter gravissimas》（英文意为“诸多重大事项之中”）是教宗格里高利十三世于1582年2月24日颁布的一道教宗谕令。该文件以拉丁文写成，改革了儒略历。这项改革后来被视为创立了一种新的历法，即以格里高利十三世命名的格里高利历。

en.t: Peasant rebels fight their final battle at Santavuori
en.s: On February 24, 1597, peasant rebels fought their final battle of the Cudgel War at Santavuori near Ilmajoki, in present-day Finland. The uprising had begun the previous year.

zh.t: 芬兰农民起义者在桑塔武奥里进行最后一战
zh.s: 1597年2月24日，农民起义者在今芬兰伊尔马约基附近的桑塔武奥里进行“棍棒战争”的最后一战。这场起义于前一年爆发。

en.t: Monteverdi’s L’Orfeo receives its first performance
en.s: On February 24, 1607, Claudio Monteverdi’s opera L’Orfeo received its first performance at the ducal court in Mantua, in present-day Italy. The exact room used for the premiere is uncertain.

zh.t: 蒙特威尔第的《奥菲欧》首次演出
zh.s: 1607年2月24日，克劳迪奥·蒙特威尔第的歌剧《奥菲欧》在今意大利曼托瓦的公爵宫廷首次演出。首演具体使用了哪个房间，目前仍不确定。

en.t: George Frideric Handel's Rinaldo, the first Italian-language opera written specifically for the London stage, premiered
en.s: Rinaldo (HWV 7) is an opera by George Frideric Handel, composed in 1711, and was the first Italian-language opera written specifically for the London stage. The libretto was prepared by Giacomo Rossi from a scenario provided by Aaron Hill, and the work was first performed at the Queen's Theatre in London's Haymarket on 24 February 1711.

zh.t: 亨德尔歌剧《里纳尔多》首演
zh.s: 《里纳尔多》（HWV 7）是乔治·弗里德里克·亨德尔创作的一部歌剧，作于1711年，是首部专为伦敦舞台创作的意大利语歌剧。歌词由贾科莫·罗西根据亚伦·希尔提供的剧情梗概编写。该剧于1711年2月24日在伦敦海马凯特的女王剧院首演。

en.s: The Battle of Karnal (February 24, 1739), was a decisive victory for Nader, the Shāh of Iran, during his invasion of Mughal India. Nader's forces defeated the army of Muhammad Shah within three hours, despite being heavily outnumbered (six-to-one), paving the way for the Persian sack of Delhi. The engagement is considered the crowning jewel in Nader's military career as well as a tactical masterpiece. The battle took place near Karnal, 110 kilometres (68 mi) north of Delhi, India. The battle was the culminating point of Nader Shah's invasion of the Mughal Empire.

zh.s: 1739年2月24日，伊朗沙阿纳迪尔在入侵莫卧儿印度期间，于卡尔纳尔战役中取得决定性胜利。莫卧儿军人数是纳迪尔军的六倍，但纳迪尔仍在三小时内击败穆罕默德沙的军队，为随后波斯军洗劫德里打开道路。这场战役被认为是纳迪尔军事生涯最出色的战绩，也是战术运用的典范。战场位于印度德里以北110公里、约68英里的卡尔纳尔附近，是纳迪尔入侵莫卧儿帝国的关键一战。

en.s: The action of 24 February 1780 was a minor naval battle that took place off the island of Madeira during the American Revolutionary War. A French convoy was intercepted and pursued by a British Royal Navy squadron ending with the French 64-gun ship Protée being captured along with three transports.

zh.s: 1780年2月24日海战是美国独立战争期间在马德拉岛附近发生的一场小规模海战。英国皇家海军分舰队拦截并追击一支法国船队，最终俘获了法国64炮舰“普罗泰号”和三艘运输船。

en.s: Pyle's Massacre, also known as Pyle's Hacking Match or the Battle of Haw River, was fought during the American Revolutionary War in Orange County, North Carolina (present-day Alamance County, North Carolina), on February 24, 1781, between Patriot and Loyalist North Carolina militia troops. Patriot militia leader Colonel Henry Lee deceived Loyalist militia under Dr. John Pyle into thinking he was British commander Banastre Tarleton sent to meet them.

zh.s: 1781年2月24日，美国独立战争期间，北卡罗来纳州奥兰治县，也就是今阿拉曼斯县，发生爱国派与效忠派民兵之间的交战，史称派尔惨案，又称派尔砍杀事件或霍河战役。爱国派民兵领袖亨利·李上校，诱使约翰·派尔医生率领的效忠派民兵相信，他就是奉命前来与他们会合的英国指挥官巴纳斯特·塔尔顿。

en.s: The Battle of Wambaw was an engagement of the American Revolutionary War fought on February 24, 1782 near Charleston, South Carolina. The British engaged and defeated an American force of dragoons and infantry near Charleston. The British claimed to kill 40 and capture 4 Americans, while the Americans claimed not to know their losses apart from 35 horses.

zh.s: 1782年2月24日，美国独立战争期间，南卡罗来纳州查尔斯顿附近发生万博战役。英军击败了一支由美军龙骑兵和步兵组成的部队。英方称击毙40名、俘虏4名美军；美方则称，除损失35匹马外，其余损失不明。

en.s: The Battle of Fishguard was a military invasion of Great Britain by Revolutionary France during the War of the First Coalition. The brief campaign, on 22–24 February 1797, is the most recent landing on British soil by a hostile foreign force and thus is often referred to as the "last invasion of mainland Britain". The French general Lazare Hoche had devised a three-pronged attack on Britain in support of the Society of United Irishmen.

zh.s: 菲什加德战役是第一次反法同盟战争期间，革命法国对大不列颠发动的军事入侵。1797年2月22日至24日的这次短暂行动，是外国敌对部队最近一次登陆英国本土，因此常被称为“英国本土最后一次遭入侵”。法国将领拉扎尔·奥什为支援联合爱尔兰人协会，策划了分三路进攻英国的行动。

en.t: The US Supreme Court decides Marbury v. Madison
en.s: On February 24, 1803, the US Supreme Court issued its decision in Marbury v. Madison. The ruling established judicial review of federal legislation by holding that a law conflicting with the Constitution could not be enforced.

zh.t: 美国最高法院裁决“马伯里诉麦迪逊案”
zh.s: 1803年2月24日，美国最高法院就“马伯里诉麦迪逊案”作出裁决。法院认定，与宪法相抵触的法律不能执行，确立了对联邦立法进行司法审查的原则。

en.s: The invasion of Martinique of 1809 was a successful British amphibious operation against the French West Indian island of Martinique that took place between 30 January and 24 February 1809 during the West Indies Campaign 1804–1810 of the Napoleonic Wars. Martinique, like nearby Guadeloupe, was a major threat to British trade in the Caribbean, providing a sheltered base from which privateers and French Navy warships could raid British shipping and disrupt the trade routes that maintained the British economy. The islands also provided a focus for larger scale French operations in the region and in the autumn of 1808, following the Spanish alliance with Britain, the Admiralty decided to order a British squadron to neutralise the threat, beginning with Martinique.

zh.s: 1809年1月30日至2月24日，英军对法国西印度群岛的马提尼克岛发动成功的两栖作战，属于拿破仑战争1804—1810年西印度群岛战事的一部分。马提尼克与邻近的瓜德罗普岛都是英国加勒比贸易的重要威胁，为私掠船及法国军舰提供安全基地，使它们能够袭击英国船只，扰乱维系英国经济的贸易航线。这些岛屿也为法国在当地开展更大规模行动提供支点。1808年秋，西班牙与英国结盟后，英国海军部决定命令一支舰队从马提尼克开始，消除这些威胁。

en.s: The Treaty of Paris of 24 February 1812 between Napoleon I of France and Frederick William III of Prussia established a Franco-Prussian alliance directed against Russia. On 24 June, Prussia joined the French invasion of Russia. The unpopular alliance broke down when the Prussian contingent in French service signed a separate armistice, the Convention of Tauroggen, with Russia on 30 December 1812.

zh.s: 法国拿破仑一世与普鲁士腓特烈·威廉三世于1812年2月24日签署《巴黎条约》，建立针对俄罗斯的法普联盟。6月24日，普鲁士加入法国对俄战争。普鲁士部队虽在法国军中服役，但于1812年12月30日与俄罗斯单独签署《陶罗根公约》停战，该联盟由此瓦解。

en.s: The sinking of HMS Peacock was a naval action fought off the mouth of the Demerara River, Guyana on 24 February 1813, between the sloop of war USS Hornet and the Cruizer-class brig-sloop HMS Peacock. After an exchange of broadsides, Hornet was able to rake Peacock, forcing her to strike. Peacock was so damaged that she sank shortly after surrendering.

zh.s: 1813年2月24日，美国单桅战舰“大黄蜂”号与英国巡洋舰级双桅战舰“孔雀”号，在圭亚那德梅拉拉河口外海交战。双方互射舷炮后，“大黄蜂”号得以沿“孔雀”号舰身纵向扫射，迫使其降旗投降。“孔雀”号损坏过重，在投降后不久沉没。

en.t: Swaminarayan inaugurates the temple at Ahmedabad
en.s: On February 24, 1822, Swaminarayan inaugurated the first temple of the Swaminarayan Sampraday at Kalupur in Ahmedabad, India.

zh.t: 斯瓦米纳拉扬在艾哈迈达巴德为教派首座寺庙举行开庙仪式
zh.s: 1822年2月24日，斯瓦米纳拉扬在印度艾哈迈达巴德的卡卢普尔，为斯瓦米纳拉扬教派的首座寺庙举行开庙仪式。

en.s: The Treaty of Yandabo (Burmese: ရန္တပိုစာချုပ် [jàɰ̃dəbò sàdʑoʊʔ]) was the peace treaty that ended the First Anglo-Burmese War. The treaty was signed on 24 February 1826, nearly two years after the war formally broke out on 5 March 1824, by General Sir Archibald Campbell on the British side, and the Governor of Legaing Maha Min Hla Kyaw Htin from the Burmese side, without any due permission and consent of the Ahom kingdom, Kachari kingdom or the other territories covered in the treaty.

zh.s: 《扬达波条约》（缅甸语：ရန္တပိုစာချုပ် [jàɰ̃dəbò sàdʑoʊʔ]）是结束第一次英缅战争的和平条约。条约于1826年2月24日签署，距战争于1824年3月5日正式爆发近两年。英方签署人为阿奇博尔德·坎贝尔爵士将军，缅方签署人为莱甘总督玛哈敏拉觉廷。签署时，阿豪姆王国、卡查尔王国及条约涉及的其他地区均未给予许可或同意。

en.t: The Treaty of Dancing Rabbit Creek, the first removal treaty in accordance with the Indian Removal Act, is proclaimed. The Choctaws in Mississippi cede land east of the river in exchange for payment and land in the West
en.s: The Treaty of Dancing Rabbit Creek was a treaty which was signed on September 27, 1830, and proclaimed on February 24, 1831, between the Choctaw American Indian tribe and the United States government. This treaty was the first removal treaty which was carried into effect under the Indian Removal Act.

zh.s: 《跳兔溪条约》于1830年9月27日由乔克托族和美国政府签署，并于1831年2月24日公布。根据该条约，密西西比州乔克托族人将河以东的土地交给美国，换取补偿和西部土地。这是依据《印第安人迁移法》实施的首份迁移条约。

en.t: US warships bombard Saoluafata on Upolu
en.s: On February 24, 1841, US warships bombarded Saoluafata on Upolu, Samoa. The attack followed the killing of an American sailor and the local chief’s refusal to hand over suspects. US forces also landed and burned villages.

zh.t: 美国军舰炮击乌波卢岛的萨奥卢阿法塔
zh.s: 1841年2月24日，美国军舰炮击萨摩亚乌波卢岛的萨奥卢阿法塔。此前一名美国水手被杀，当地首领拒绝交出嫌疑人。美军还登陆并焚烧村庄。

en.t: Louis Philippe abdicates during the French Revolution of 1848
en.s: On February 24, 1848, King Louis Philippe abdicated in Paris, France, in favour of his young grandson Philippe. His departure did not preserve the monarchy, and the Second Republic followed.

zh.t: 路易-菲利普在法国二月革命中退位
zh.s: 1848年2月24日，法国国王路易-菲利普在巴黎退位，试图把王位交给年幼的孙子菲利普。但君主制并未因此保住，法国随后成立第二共和国。

en.t: A provisional government is formed during the French Revolution
en.s: On February 24, 1848, a provisional government was formed in Paris, France, after Louis Philippe’s abdication. Its members were announced to the crowd outside the Hôtel de Ville that evening.

zh.t: 法国二月革命中组成临时政府
zh.s: 1848年2月24日，路易-菲利普退位后，法国巴黎组成临时政府。当天傍晚，政府成员的名单向市政厅外的民众公布。

en.s: The Battle of Cibakháza was one of the several battles for the bridge over the Tisza river from Cibakháza in the Hungarian war of Independence of 1848-1849, fought on 24 February 1849 between the Hungarian troops defending the bridge led by Major Károly Leiningen-Westerburg and the troops of the Austrian Empire, led by Major General Ferenc Ottinger, who were trying to capture and destroy it, in order to prevent the Hungarian incursions on the right bank of the river.

zh.s: 西巴克哈佐战役是匈牙利独立战争期间，蒂萨河西巴克哈佐桥梁争夺战中的一场战斗，于1849年2月24日发生。卡罗伊·莱宁根-韦斯特堡少校率领匈牙利军队守桥，费伦茨·奥廷格少将率领奥地利帝国军队试图夺桥并将其摧毁，以阻止匈牙利军队进入河右岸。

en.s: The Battle of Dobra took place on February 24, 1863 near the village of Dobra, Russian-controlled Congress Poland. It was one of many skirmishes of the January Uprising, the anti-Russian rebellion of Poles. On February 22, 1863, an insurgent unit of Jozef Sawicki and dr. Jozef Dworaczek, arrived at the town of Zgierz. The unit had some 300 men, including 60 riflemen, 210 kosynierzy, and 30 cavalry. With food supplies received in Zgierz, the insurgents marched to the forest near the village of Dobra, where they camped. The Poles were immediately followed by a group of the Imperial Russian Army, which consisted on infantry and Cossacks.

zh.s: 1863年2月24日，在俄国控制的波兰会议王国多布拉村附近发生战斗，这是一月起义中波兰人反俄的众多小规模交战之一。2月22日，约瑟夫·萨维茨基及约瑟夫·德沃拉切克医生率起义部队抵达兹盖日。部队约300人，包括60名步枪手、210名持镰刀步兵和30名骑兵。他们在兹盖日获得粮食补给后，前往多布拉附近的森林扎营，俄国帝国陆军的步兵与哥萨克随即跟踪而来。

en.s: Battle of Małogoszcz took place on February 24, 1863, near Małogoszcz in the Holy Cross voivodeship. It was the one of biggest battles of the January Uprising. Polish general Marian Langiewicz began concentrating his forces in the Holy Cross Mountains; he wanted to attack Warsaw with them, but the Russians unveiled his attempts. He was attacked by a few Russian forces simultaneously. Langiewicz defeated them all in many skirmishes. Polish forces grew to 2,600 men. Russian colonel Dobrowolski attacked near Małogoszcz. The Russians shelled Polish positions, but their attack was eventually smashed by a Polish cavalry counterattack. Langiewicz ordered a retreat.

zh.s: 1863年2月24日，圣十字地区马沃戈什奇附近发生战役，是一月起义中规模最大的战斗之一。波兰将军马里安·兰吉维奇开始在圣十字山脉集结部队，打算进攻华沙，但计划被俄军发现。他同时受到数支俄军攻击，却在多次小规模交战中将其击败，部队人数增至2600人。俄军多布罗沃尔斯基上校随后在马沃戈什奇附近发动进攻并炮击波军阵地，但攻势最终被波兰骑兵反击击溃。兰吉维奇随后下令撤退。

en.t: The US House impeaches President Andrew Johnson
en.s: On February 24, 1868, the US House of Representatives voted 128 to 47 to impeach President Andrew Johnson, chiefly over his dismissal of Secretary of War Edwin Stanton. Johnson was later acquitted by the Senate.

zh.t: 美国众议院弹劾总统安德鲁·约翰逊
zh.s: 1868年2月24日，美国众议院以128票赞成、47票反对弹劾总统安德鲁·约翰逊，主要原因是他解职战争部长埃德温·斯坦顿。参议院后来未将他定罪。

en.t: Peer Gynt receives its stage premiere in Christiania
en.s: On February 24, 1876, Henrik Ibsen’s play Peer Gynt received its first stage performance in Christiania, now Oslo, Norway. Edvard Grieg composed the incidental music.

zh.t: 《培尔·金特》在克里斯蒂安尼亚首次登台演出
zh.s: 1876年2月24日，亨利克·易卜生的戏剧《培尔·金特》在挪威克里斯蒂安尼亚，也就是今天的奥斯陆，首次登台演出。舞台配乐由爱德华·格里格创作。

en.s: The Treaty of Saint Petersburg or Treaty of Ili was an unequal treaty between the Russian Empire and the Qing dynasty that was signed in Saint Petersburg, Russia, on 24 February [O.S. 12 February] 1881. It provided for the return to China of the eastern part of the Ili Basin region, also known as Zhetysu, which had been occupied by Russia since 1871 during the Dungan Revolt.

zh.s: 《圣彼得堡条约》又称《伊犁条约》，是俄罗斯帝国与清朝签订的一项不平等条约。条约于1881年2月24日（儒略历2月12日）在俄罗斯圣彼得堡签署。根据条约，俄罗斯将伊犁河谷东部归还中国；该地区也称七河地区，自1871年东干起义期间起由俄罗斯占领。

en.s: On February 24, 1891, French forces led by Louis Archinard captured Djenné from the Tukulor Empire, in present-day Mali.

zh.s: 1891年2月24日，路易·阿尔希纳尔率领的法军从图库洛尔帝国手中攻占杰内，地点位于今马里境内。

en.s: On February 24, 1895, an uprising against Spanish rule began in Cuba, opening the Cuban War of Independence. The war continued until 1898.

zh.t: 古巴反对西班牙统治的独立起义爆发
zh.s: 1895年2月24日，古巴爆发反对西班牙统治的起义，古巴独立战争由此开始。战争持续到1898年。

en.s: The Battle of Beirut was a naval battle off the coast of Beirut during the Italo-Turkish War. Italian fears that the Ottoman naval forces at Beirut could be used to threaten the approach to the Suez canal led the Italian military to order the destruction of the Ottoman naval presence in the area. On 24 February 1912 two Italian armoured cruisers attacked and sank an Ottoman casemate corvette and six lighters, retired, then returned and sank an Ottoman torpedo boat. As a result of the battle all Ottoman naval forces in the region were annihilated, thus ensuring the approaches to the Suez Canal were open to the Italians.

zh.s: 贝鲁特海战发生在意土战争期间的贝鲁特外海。意大利担心当地奥斯曼海军威胁通往苏伊士运河的航道，因此下令消灭这支海上力量。1912年2月24日，两艘意大利装甲巡洋舰发动攻击，击沉一艘奥斯曼炮廓式护卫舰及六艘驳船，撤离后又返回，击沉一艘奥斯曼鱼雷艇。该地区奥斯曼海军因此全军覆没，意大利通往苏伊士运河的航道得以畅通。

en.s: The 1916 North Louth by-election was held on 24 February 1916. The by-election was held due to the death of the incumbent Irish Parliamentary MP, Augustine Roche. It was won by the Irish Parliamentary candidate Patrick Whitty. Whitty received some Unionist support, while Hamill received separatist support. Whitty was aged just 21, becoming the youngest MP at the time.

zh.s: 北劳斯选区于1916年2月24日举行补选。原任爱尔兰议会党议员奥古斯丁·罗奇去世后，该席位出现空缺。爱尔兰议会党候选人帕特里克·惠蒂获胜。他获得了一些统一派人士的支持，哈米尔则得到分离派人士支持。惠蒂当时年仅21岁，成为当时最年轻的议员。

en.s: General elections to the Cortes Generales were held in Spain on 24 February 1918. At stake were all 409 seats in the Congress of Deputies. The 1918 general election represented a break in the customary turno system, and saw the Liberals retained in power.

zh.s: 西班牙于1918年2月24日举行大选，改选众议院全部409个议席。这次选举打破了惯常的两党轮流执政安排，自由派继续掌权。

en.s: The Estonian Declaration of Independence, also known as the Manifesto to the Peoples of Estonia (Estonian: Manifest Eestimaa rahvastele), is the founding act which established the independent democratic Republic of Estonia on 24 February 1918. Since then, 24 February has been celebrated as Estonian Independence Day, the national day of Estonia.

zh.s: 《爱沙尼亚独立宣言》又称《告爱沙尼亚人民宣言》，是爱沙尼亚于1918年2月24日建立独立民主共和国的建国文件。此后，2月24日一直作为爱沙尼亚国庆日——独立日庆祝。

en.t: Hitler presents the Nazi Party’s 25-point programme in Munich
en.s: On February 24, 1920, Adolf Hitler presented a 25-point party programme at a public meeting in Munich, Germany. The meeting marked the emergence of the renamed National Socialist German Workers’ Party from the German Workers’ Party.

zh.t: 希特勒在慕尼黑公布纳粹党的二十五点纲领
zh.s: 1920年2月24日，阿道夫·希特勒在德国慕尼黑的一次公众集会上公布政党二十五点纲领。这次集会标志着德国工人党改名为国家社会主义德国工人党，即纳粹党。

en.s: The Struma disaster was the sinking on 24 February 1942 of the ship MV Struma which had been trying to take nearly 800 Jewish refugees from the Axis member Romania to Mandatory Palestine. She was a small iron-hulled ship of only 240 GRT and had been built in 1867 as a steam-powered schooner but had recently been re-engined with an unreliable second-hand diesel engine.

zh.s: 斯特鲁马号灾难指移民船斯特鲁马号于1942年2月24日沉没。当时这艘船正试图从轴心国成员国罗马尼亚运送近800名犹太难民前往巴勒斯坦托管地。该船船体由铁制成，吨位仅240总吨，1867年建成时是一艘蒸汽帆船，近期刚换装一台状况不可靠的二手柴油发动机。

en.s: The Battle of Los Angeles, also known as the Great Los Angeles Air Raid, is the name given by contemporary sources to a rumored attack on the continental United States by Imperial Japan and the subsequent anti-aircraft artillery barrage which took place from late February 24, to early February 25, 1942, over Los Angeles, California. Five civilians died during the barrage and four Japanese aircraft were erroneously reported shot down.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: “洛杉矶空袭事件”又称“大洛杉矶空袭”，当时的资料用这个名称指一场传闻中的日本帝国对美国本土的袭击，以及随后发生的防空炮火拦截。事件发生于1942年2月24日深夜至25日凌晨，地点在加利福尼亚州洛杉矶上空。炮火造成五名平民死亡；当时还误报击落了四架日本飞机。

en.t: Soviet forces close the Lower Silesian offensive near Forst
en.s: On February 24, 1945, Soviet forces closed the Lower Silesian offensive after securing a small bridgehead across the Neisse near Forst, in present-day Germany. The siege of Breslau continued separately.

zh.t: 苏军在福斯特附近结束下西里西亚攻势
zh.s: 1945年2月24日，苏军在今德国福斯特附近夺得尼斯河对岸的一小片桥头阵地后，结束下西里西亚攻势。布雷斯劳的围城战仍在继续。

en.s: Operation Southwind (German: Unternehmen Südwind) was a German offensive operation on the Eastern Front in Hungary, from 17–24 February 1945. The Germans succeeded in eliminating the Soviet bridgehead on the west bank of the river Hron in preparation for Operation Spring Awakening. This was one of the last successful German offensives in the Second World War.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 南风行动（德语：Unternehmen Südwind）是第二次世界大战东线战场匈牙利境内的一次德军进攻行动，于1945年2月17日至24日进行。德军成功消灭了赫龙河西岸的苏军桥头堡，为春季觉醒行动做准备。这是第二次世界大战中德军最后几次成功的进攻之一。

en.s: General elections were held in Argentina on 24 February 1946. They were the last for which only men were enfranchised. Voters chose both the president and their legislators.

zh.s: 阿根廷于1946年2月24日举行大选，选出总统和议员。这是该国最后一次只有男性享有选举权的选举。

en.s: The Louisiana gubernatorial election of 1948 was held in two rounds on January 20 and February 24, 1948. Like most Southern statesbetween Reconstruction and the civil rights era, Louisiana's Republican Party was virtually nonexistent in terms of electoral support. This meant that the two Democratic Party primaries held on these dates were the real contest over who would be governor. The 1948 election saw the defeat of Louisiana's reformer "anti-Long" faction and the election of Earl Kemp Long to his first full term as governor. Under Louisiana's constitution, incumbent governor Jimmie Davis could not succeed himself in a consecutive term.

zh.s: 1948年路易斯安那州州长选举的两轮投票分别于1月20日和2月24日举行。从重建时期到民权运动时代，路易斯安那与多数美国南方州一样，共和党在选举中几乎没有支持基础，因此这两轮民主党初选实际上决定了州长人选。主张改革的“反朗派”落败，厄尔·肯普·朗当选，开始首个完整州长任期。根据州宪法，现任州长吉米·戴维斯不能连续连任。

en.t: Egypt and Israel sign a general armistice agreement in Rhodes
en.s: On February 24, 1949, Egypt and Israel signed a general armistice agreement in Rhodes, Greece. It took effect by signature. The separate armistices with other Arab states followed later.

zh.t: 埃及与以色列在罗得岛签署全面停战协定
zh.s: 1949年2月24日，埃及与以色列在希腊罗得岛签署全面停战协定，协定在签署后生效。以色列与其他阿拉伯国家的停战协定则在此后分别签署。

en.t: Legislative Yuan members convene in Taipei after relocation
en.s: On February 24, 1950, 380 members of the Legislative Yuan convened at Sun Yat-sen Hall in Taipei, Taiwan, following the legislature’s relocation from mainland China.

zh.t: 立法院迁台后在台北集会
zh.s: 1950年2月24日，380名立法委员在台湾台北的中山堂集会。此前，立法院已从中国大陆迁往台湾。

en.t: On 24 February 1953, the Legislative Yuan of the Republic of China, which retreated to Taiwan, voted to officially terminate its commitments to the Sino-Soviet Treaty of Friendship and Alliance as well and rescinded its recognition of the independence of the Mongolian People's Republic
en.s: The Treaty of Friendship and Alliance (Chinese: 中蘇友好同盟條約, Russian: Договор о дружбе и союзе между СССР и Китайской Республикой) was a treaty signed by the National Government of the Republic of China and the Government of the Union of Soviet Socialist Republics on 14 August 1945, at the time of Japan's surrender. Soviet and Mongolian troops then occupied Inner Mongolia and Manchuria, after they had seized it from the Japanese during World War II.

zh.t: 中华民国立法院宣布终止履行《中苏友好同盟条约》并撤销对蒙古人民共和国的承认
zh.s: 《中苏友好同盟条约》（中文：中蘇友好同盟條約；俄语：Договор о дружбе и союзе между СССР и Китайской Республикой）由中华民国国民政府和苏维埃社会主义共和国联盟政府于1945年8月14日签署，当时日本刚刚投降。此后，苏联和蒙古军队占领了内蒙古和满洲；此前，二战期间两军已从日军手中夺取这些地区。

en.s: The third legislative assembly election to the Madras state (presently Tamil Nadu) was held between 17 and 24 February 1962. The Indian National Congress party, led by K. Kamaraj, won the election. Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam made significant in-roads in the election and emerged as the second party for the first time by winning 50 seats.

zh.s: 马德拉斯邦，也就是今泰米尔纳德邦，于1962年2月17日至24日举行第三届邦议会选举。K.卡马拉杰领导的印度国民大会党获胜。达罗毗荼进步联盟取得明显进展，赢得50席，首次成为第二大党。

en.s: The 1966 Ghanaian coup d'état (codenamed Operation Cold Chop) was a military overthrow of President Kwame Nkrumah on February 24, 1966, while he was visiting China. The swift coup led to the establishment of an eight-member National Liberation Council (NLC), comprising four army and four police officers. The NLC dissolved Nkrumah's Convention People's Party and the Parliament, and suspended the constitution.

zh.s: 1966年2月24日，加纳总统夸梅·恩克鲁玛访问中国期间，军方发动代号“冷切行动”的政变将其推翻。政变迅速完成，随后成立八人组成的全国解放委员会，包括四名军官及四名警官。委员会解散恩克鲁玛领导的人民大会党及议会，并暂停实施宪法。

en.s: The Battle of Suoi Bong Trang (23–24 February 1966) was an engagement fought between US, Australian and New Zealand forces, and the Viet Cong and North Vietnamese Army during the Vietnam War. The battle occurred during Operation Rolling Stone, an American security operation to protect engineers building a tactically important road in the vicinity of Tan Binh, in central Binh Duong Province, 30 kilometres (19 mi) north-west of Bien Hoa airbase.

zh.s: 水泷庄战役于1966年2月23日至24日发生，是越南战争期间的一场战斗。交战双方是美国、澳大利亚和新西兰军队，以及越共和北越军队。战斗发生在滚雷行动期间；美军正在新平附近修建一条具有战术重要性的道路，并以此为由开展安全行动。新平位于平阳省中部，距边和空军基地西北约30公里（19英里）。

en.s: A by-election was held for the Australian House of Representatives seat of Higgins on 24 February 1968. It was triggered by the presumed death of then-current Prime Minister and Liberal Party MP Harold Holt. On 15 January 1968, the speaker stated that there was conclusive evidence that Holt had died, and that a writ would be issued for the by-election. Senator John Gorton, who had been elected party leader and Prime Minister by his party colleagues on 9 January, was preselected unopposed to run for the Liberal Party on 31 January.

zh.s: 1968年2月24日，澳大利亚众议院希金斯选区举行补选，原因是时任总理兼自由党议员哈罗德·霍尔特被推定已死亡。1月15日，众议院议长表示，已有确凿证据证明霍尔特死亡，将发布补选令。参议员约翰·戈顿于1月9日获党内同僚选为党魁并出任总理，随后在1月31日无竞争地获自由党提名，参加这次补选。

en.s: The 1968 New South Wales state election was held on 24 February 1968. It was conducted in single member constituencies with compulsory preferential voting and was held on boundaries created at a 1966 redistribution. The election was for all of the 94 seats in the Legislative Assembly.

zh.s: 1968年新南威尔士州选举于1968年2月24日举行。选举采用单议席选区和强制偏好投票制，选区边界按1966年重新划分后的方案确定。立法议会全部94个席位均参与选举。

en.t: South Vietnamese forces raise their flag over Huế’s citadel
en.s: On February 24, 1968, South Vietnamese troops raised their flag over the citadel in Huế, Vietnam, and recaptured the Imperial Palace later that day. Fighting in the citadel continued into the following day.

zh.t: 南越军队在顺化城堡升旗并夺回皇城
zh.s: 1968年2月24日，南越军队在越南顺化城堡升起旗帜，当天稍后夺回皇城。城堡内仍有战斗持续到次日。

en.s: The Northern Ireland general election, 1969 was held on Monday 24 February 1969. It was the last election to the Parliament of Northern Ireland before its abolition by the Northern Ireland Constitution Act 1973. Unlike previous elections that produced a large unambiguous majority for the Ulster Unionist Party, this one give more complex results. The Ulster Unionists were divided over a variety of reforms introduced by Prime Minister Terence O'Neill and this division spilled over into the election with official Ulster Unionist candidates standing either in support of or opposition to O'Neill and a number of independent pro O'Neill Unionists standing against opposing candidates.

zh.s: 1969年北爱尔兰大选于2月24日星期一举行，是北爱尔兰议会根据《1973年北爱尔兰宪法法》被撤销前的最后一次选举。以往选举通常让阿尔斯特统一党取得明确而庞大的多数，这次结果却更为复杂。该党因首相特伦斯·奥尼尔推出的多项改革而分裂，分歧也延伸到选举：正式候选人中有人支持奥尼尔，有人反对他；另有一些支持奥尼尔的独立统一派人士，出面挑战反奥尼尔候选人。

en.s: General elections were held in Western Samoa on 24 February 1973. All candidates ran as independents and voting was restricted to Faʻamatai and citizens of European origin ("individual voters"), with the matai electing 45 MPs and Europeans two. Following the election, Fiamē Mataʻafa Faumuina Mulinuʻu II became Prime Minister for a second term, having previously held the office between 1959 and 1970.

zh.s: 西萨摩亚于1973年2月24日举行大选。所有候选人均以独立人士身份参选。只有传统首领制度中的马泰，以及被称为“个人选民”的欧洲裔公民有投票权；马泰选出45名议员，欧洲裔选民选出2名。菲亚梅·马塔阿法·福穆伊纳·穆利努乌二世再次出任总理，开始第二个任期。他此前曾于1959年至1970年担任总理。

en.s: The 1973 Oceania Cup final was a football match that took place on 24 February 1973 to determine the winners of the 1973 Oceania Cup. It was the final of the first Oceania Cup, a tournament contested by the senior men's national teams of the member associations of OFC to decide the champions of Oceania. New Zealand won their inaugural Oceania Cup, beating Tahiti 2–0.

zh.s: 1973年大洋洲杯决赛于1973年2月24日举行，决出首届大洋洲杯冠军。该赛事由大洋洲足球联合会成员协会的成年男子国家队参加。新西兰以2比0击败塔希提，首次夺得大洋洲杯冠军。

en.s: On February 24, 1974, Pondicherry, now Puducherry, India, held its legislative assembly election for 30 seats. The All India Anna Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam won the largest number of seats.

zh.t: 本地治里举行议会选举
zh.s: 1974年2月24日，印度本地治里举行议会选举，改选30个议席。全印安纳达罗毗荼进步联盟赢得最多议席。

en.s: The 1976 New Hampshire Republican presidential primary was held on February 24, 1976, in New Hampshire as one of the Republican Party's statewide nomination contests ahead of the 1976 United States presidential election. Incumbent President Gerald Ford eked out a razor-thin victory over the more conservative Ronald Reagan by just 1,587 votes, or 1.5 percentage points.

en.s: A by-election was held in the Bermondsey constituency in South London, on 24 February 1983, following the resignation of Labour MP Bob Mellish. Peter Tatchell stood as the candidate for the Labour Party, and Simon Hughes stood for the Liberal Party. Following a bitter campaign, the Liberals made huge gains and took the seat, with a majority of votes cast. Labour's vote fell from 63.6 per cent in May 1979 to 26.1 per cent as Tatchell came a distant second, while the Conservative candidate, Robert Hughes, managed only fourth place. With a swing of 44.2%, the 1983 Bermondsey by-election remains the largest by-election swing in British political history.

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Cuba on 24 February 1993 alongside elections to the fourteen Provincial Assemblies. Following the implementation of a new electoral law in 1992, voters now elected the National Assembly directly (previously voters had elected members of the country's 169 Municipal Assemblies, who in turn had elected the National Assembly). en.t: Mahathir Mohamad submits his resignation as Malaysian prime minister
en.s: On February 24, 2020, Mahathir Mohamad submitted his resignation as prime minister to Malaysia’s king amid a political crisis. The king then appointed him interim prime minister until a successor could be chosen.

zh.t: 马哈蒂尔·穆罕默德辞去马来西亚总理职务
zh.s: 2020年2月24日，马哈蒂尔·穆罕默德在政治危机中向马来西亚国王提交总理辞呈。国王随后任命他为过渡总理，直到选出接任者。

en.s: On 24 February 2022, the Chuhuiv Air Base in Chuhuiv, Kharkiv Oblast, Ukraine was the target of an air strike by Russian forces as part of the eastern Ukraine offensive during the Russian invasion of Ukraine.

zh.s: 2022年2月24日，俄罗斯入侵乌克兰期间，俄军空袭乌克兰哈尔科夫州丘胡伊夫市的丘胡伊夫空军基地。这是俄军在乌克兰东部攻势的一部分。

en.s: On 24 February 2022, during the Russo-Ukrainian war, Russia launched a full-scale invasion of Ukraine, starting the current phase of the war, the largest conflict in Europe since World War II. By April 2022, the invasion's initial goal of a rapid Russian victory via decapitation had failed, with Ukraine pushing back the northern arm of the invasion and preventing the capture of Kyiv.

zh.s: 2022年2月24日，在俄乌战争期间，俄罗斯对乌克兰发动全面入侵，开启了战争当前阶段。这是第二次世界大战以来欧洲规模最大的冲突。到2022年4月，俄罗斯试图迅速取胜并推翻乌克兰领导层的初期目标已经失败；乌克兰击退了俄军北线攻势，阻止其攻占基辅。

en.t: Southern front of the Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)
en.s: On 24 February 2022, the Russian military invaded Kherson Oblast in southern Ukraine from Russian-occupied Crimea, quickly entering Mykolaiv Oblast and Zaporizhzhia Oblast amid battles with the Armed Forces of Ukraine. Elements from the southern Russian offensive joined forces with elements advancing from the Donbas to jointly surround and bombard the city of Mariupol in Donetsk Oblast, which fell after months of siege.

zh.t: 俄乌战争南线战场（2022年至今）
zh.s: 2022年2月24日，俄罗斯军队从俄占克里米亚进入乌克兰南部的赫尔松州，随后迅速进入尼古拉耶夫州和扎波罗热州，并与乌克兰武装部队交战。俄军南线攻势的部分部队与从顿巴斯推进的部队会合，共同包围并炮击顿涅茨克州马里乌波尔市。经过数月围困，该市最终陷落。

en.t: Russian airstrikes hit the Odesa region on the invasion’s first day
en.s: On February 24, 2022, Russian airstrikes hit warehouses and military radar and air-defence facilities in Ukraine’s Odesa region as the full-scale invasion began.

zh.t: 俄军在全面入侵首日空袭敖德萨地区
zh.s: 2022年2月24日，俄罗斯全面入侵乌克兰当天，俄军空袭乌克兰敖德萨地区的仓库、军用雷达和防空设施。

en.s: During the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine, the Chernobyl Exclusion Zone was captured on 24 February, the first day of the invasion, by the Russian Armed Forces, who entered Ukrainian territory from neighbouring Belarus and seized the entire area of the Chernobyl Nuclear Power Plant by the end of that day.

zh.t: 切尔诺贝利控制区被占领
zh.s: 2022年俄罗斯入侵乌克兰首日，即2月24日，俄军从邻国白俄罗斯进入乌克兰，占领切尔诺贝利禁区，并在当天结束前控制了整个切尔诺贝利核电站区域。

en.t: Russian forces attack military sites in Lviv Oblast
en.s: On February 24, 2022, Russian forces attacked military sites in Brody, Novyi Kalyniv and Kamianka-Buzka in Ukraine’s Lviv Oblast. These were attacks in the wider region, not a claim that every later strike on Lviv city occurred that day.

zh.t: 俄军袭击利沃夫州的军事设施
zh.s: 2022年2月24日，俄军袭击乌克兰利沃夫州布罗迪、新卡利尼夫和卡缅卡-布兹卡的军事设施。这里记录的是州内这些地点当天遭袭的情况。

en.t: Russian forces begin advancing towards Kharkiv
en.s: On February 24, 2022, Russian forces crossed into Ukraine and advanced towards Kharkiv as the full-scale invasion began. Ukrainian troops took positions on key approaches and residents began volunteering for military service.

zh.t: 俄军越境向哈尔科夫推进
zh.s: 2022年2月24日，俄罗斯全面入侵乌克兰，俄军越境向哈尔科夫推进。乌军在通往该市的主要道路部署，居民也开始报名参军。

en.t: A missile attack hits military warehouses in Kryvyi Rih
en.s: On February 24, 2022, Russian forces attacked military warehouses of Ukraine’s 17th Mechanized Brigade near the Makulan neighbourhood of Kryvyi Rih, Ukraine.

zh.t: 克里维里赫的军用仓库遭导弹袭击
zh.s: 2022年2月24日，俄军袭击乌克兰克里维里赫马库兰居民区附近、隶属第十七机械化旅的军用仓库。

en.s: On 24 February 2022, the Russian military invaded Ukraine, crossing the Russia-Ukraine and Belarus–Ukraine borders at several points in Chernihiv Oblast. Russian troops unsuccessfully attempted to capture the capital city of the oblast, Chernihiv, as part of a strategy to reach the Ukraine's capital Kyiv from the east.

en.s: A by-election was held in the Vaimauga 3 constituency in Samoa on 24 February 2023. The by-election was triggered by the death of the incumbent member of parliament Tapunuu Niko Lee Hang of the Human Rights Protection Party (HRPP), in November 2022. A constituency widely considered an HRPP stronghold, former shipping executive Lautimuia Uelese Vaʻai of the ruling Faʻatuatua i le Atua Samoa ua Tasi (FAST) party won the by-election with 56%.

zh.s: 萨摩亚瓦伊毛加第三选区于2023年2月24日举行补选。原任人权保护党议员塔普努乌·尼科·李杭于2022年11月去世，导致议席空缺。该选区广被视为人权保护党的稳固选区，但执政的“信仰统一萨摩亚党”（FAST）候选人、前航运业高管劳蒂穆亚·乌埃莱塞·瓦艾，最终以56%的选票获胜。

en.s: The 2024 South Carolina Republican presidential primary was held on February 24, 2024, as part of the Republican Party primaries for the 2024 presidential election. 50 delegates to the 2024 Republican National Convention were allocated on a selection basis. Held following the Iowa caucuses, the New Hampshire primary, the Nevada primary and caucuses, and the United States Virgin Islands caucuses, the South Carolina primary was the fifth Republican contest in which delegates were awarded to take place this election.

zh.t: 2024年南卡罗来纳州共和党总统初选
zh.s: 2024年2月24日，南卡罗来纳州举行共和党总统初选，作为该党2024年总统候选人提名程序的一部分，分配参加共和党全国代表大会的50名代表。此前已举行艾奥瓦州党团会议、新罕布什尔州初选、内华达州初选和党团会议，以及美属维尔京群岛党团会议。南卡罗来纳是本轮选举中第五场实际分配代表的共和党提名竞逐。
